definitions.explanation: The light emitted by the sun; often used in literary or poetic contexts.

examples.japanese: {陽光|ようこう}が{窓|まど}から{差|さ}し{込|こ}む。
{暖|あたた}かい{陽光|ようこう}を{浴|あ}びる。
{陽光|ようこう}に{照|て}らされた{庭|にわ}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The garden bathed in sunlight is beautiful.

notes:
{陽光|ようこう} is a literary or poetic word for sunlight, evoking warmth and brightness. It appears more often in writing (novels, essays, travel descriptions) than in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陽光|ようこう}が{差|さ}し{込|こ}む: sunlight streams in
- {陽光|ようこう}を{浴|あ}びる: to bathe in sunlight
- {陽光|ようこう}に{照|て}らされる: to be illuminated by sunlight
- {暖|あたた}かい{陽光|ようこう}: warm sunshine
- {陽光|ようこう}{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ: sunlight pouring down

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日光|にっこう}: sunlight (neutral tone; also the place name Nikko)
- {日差|ひざ}し: sunshine (common everyday word)
- {太陽光|たいようこう}: solar light (technical, as in {太陽光|たいようこう}パネル, solar panel)
- {陽|ひ}: sun, sunlight (literary/classical)
